predictions: Obviously, we are missing a whole bunch of last week's results. Still ten matches yet to be played as of the time that I'm writing this column. But for the matches that did get played already, I've posted a pretty strong 11-3 record so far (including my first 3-0 week in B!). That brings me to 73-37 (66.4% correct) so far, basically through four and a half weeks. With my hot streak in B, it's now D division (9-9) that is my worst record so far. I've only hit 1 of the last 6 picks in D… eek.

Match of the week: (A Div.) Talladega Flights @ Bully for the Element. Oh, it's a big couple days coming at the top of the RDL ladder. Not only do we have this matchup of the last two undefeated teams in A, we also have Element playing its postponed week 5 match with Show Me (the only remaining 1-loss team) the next day. That is a whole lot of clarity to come in a two-day span… unless Element wins on Wed. and Show Me wins on Thu. In which case, this whole thing would go into an exciting fog instead. Element completes fog step 1 here, 14-10.

Match #2: (G Div.) Flight Risks @ Heart of Dartness. G division has separated into a super-duper-clear top-three/bottom-four scenario, with the three leaders all still undefeated up to yesterday (Tuesday). This pairing is the second huge showdown in two days for the Risks. And it's also the day that Dartness starts establishing their order, 14-10.

Match #3: (B Div.) Why So Serious? @ Double In Stumble Out. Every B team had taken a loss by week 3, and we now sit with only three who haven't already taken a second one. Here are two of that lead threesome in what is obviously a huge matchup. Super tight pairing, but I think I'm feeling Serious taking the last 501 here, 13-11.

Match #4: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Bottoms Up. This duo is just one week 4 Duck uprising from being a monster undefeated showdown. As it stands, it's still a critical matchup within the lead trio in E (with the aforementioned Ducks as the third wheel). While I really like the Cheapies, the Bottoms are the real deal in E and win this one, 14-10.

Match #5: (F Div.) Dart Knights @ Death Throw. With the 'Facts taking a loss in their last match, these two are suddenly ready to take over first with just a couple wins. Huge matchup here, and I think this one could go the distance. I'll take the Knights in a tiebreaker.

Match #6: (D Div.) Liquor Possee @ Dirty Darts Done Dirt Cheap. The Possee just keeps going w-l-w-l-w, so it seems pretty clear to where that cycle leads. But if they can break the cycle and hand Dirty its 2nd straight loss (or at least 2nd in the last 3, depending on how Tuesday went), they're a contender. Alas, it's Dirty, 15-9.

Match #7: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ The Dartifacts. By the time this one is played, the Kings will have played themselves right into the heart of the title fight or into a bottom-half spot a couple matches behind. Either way, I'm guessing Dartifacts bounce back, 14-10.

Match #8: (C Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Shooter McGavin. Only one division has every team having both at least one win and one loss, meaning every team is within three matches of first. Every C match is huge. The Bandits have gotten hot lately… OAB, 13-11.

Match #9: (G Div.) Game of Throws @ 21 Dart Salute. G division has turned into two incredibly tight races. Here's the next round in the lower half group of four, all separated by one loss. Salute, 15-9.
Match #10: (F Div.) She-nanigans @ Nein Mark. Maybe we call this the "aw, dammit" bowl - at least five losses between them that were so dang close to being wins. Nein gets over the hump, 14-10.
Match #11: (D Div.) One Dart Wonders @ Irish Ton. The One Dart Wonders are in a much better position than the Irish so far. So why am I feeling an Irish win here?! I don't know either. Irish, 13-11.
Match #12: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Shark Shooters. With the last undefeated F team going down, these two are clearly still in the title fight. She Said builds on their big win here, 13-11.
And the remaining 12 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: Fringe 16, Dart Attack 8; Show Me 17, Consistent 7.
B Division: Hump Day! 14, Kids 10; The Outlaws 14, Mafia 10.
C Division: Secrets 14, Village Idiots 10; Nine Lives 13, Rif Raf 11.
D Division: Sanchez 13, Off Constantly 11; Menace 14, Rangers 10.
E Division: Runs with Corks 14, Bangin The Wire 10; Ton 80 Proof 13, Rippin Darts 11; Waddle Out 14, Sharky's Machine 10.
G Division: We're Sexy & We Throw It 13, Flight Club 11.
